subject: Naya Power as a human-AI collaboration operating architecture
aliases: nine dimensions of AI operating relationship
authority: Naya Power strategic architecture / product narrative

provenance.external-validation-claim: AI-generated evaluations described by Shawn are preserved as reported evidence, not scientific validation

evidence: Naya Power canonical README defines Naya Power as a model-independent runtime architecture for reliable, verifiable, recoverable, continuous human-AI collaboration.
Naya Power Smart Notes + CIS Constitution defines Note Events, Naya/Human representations, verification receipts, project-first memory, provenance, and AI-to-AI handoff.
Shawn-provided narrative defines nine core dimensions: Personality, Brain, Notes, Lead Mode, Law, Scorecarding, Language, Design, and Coder.
Shawn-provided narrative establishes the customer outcome as increased human capability rather than AI replacement.

naya.summary: Naya Power is an operating architecture for the relationship between human intention and artificial intelligence, reducing operational burden while increasing reliability, continuity, shared meaning, quality control, initiative, design quality, and implementation quality.
naya.content: Configure the intelligence and the working relationship, not merely the prompt.
lessons: The human remains the point; AI carries more operational burden without annexing human agency.
Naya Power is a governed operating architecture rather than a prompt library.
The nine systems work together as one coherent architecture.
next_best_actions: Use this architecture as the governing product and operating model for future Naya work.

human.summary: Shawn's strategic framing is that Naya Power should be presented as a coherent architecture for human-AI collaboration, not merely a chatbot, prompt library, or branded feature set.
human.content: Build for the human, not the machine.
lessons: Independent AI evaluations are reported evidence, not scientific validation.
The customer test is whether an ordinary human can accomplish meaningful complicated work with Naya carrying more of the operational burden.
next_best_actions: Preserve human capability as the product north star.
